fn wrap_with_limited_retries<T, C>(ctor: C, max_retries: usize) -> std::io::Result<StubbornIo<T, C>>
where
    T: UnderlyingIo<C> + tokio::io::AsyncRead + tokio::io::AsyncWrite,
    C: Clone + Send + Unpin + 'static,
{
    let reconnect_options = ReconnectOptions::new()
        .with_max_retries(max_retries)
        .with_backoff(Duration::from_millis(100))
        .with_backoff_multiplier(2.0)
        .with_initial_backoff(Duration::from_millis(50))
        .with_jitter(Duration::from_millis(10))
        .with_max_backoff(Duration::from_secs(30));
    StubbornIo::new(ctor, reconnect_options)
}

fn links_to_component(manifest: &crate::Manifest, target_name: &str) -> Vec<LinkProperty> {
    manifest
        .links
        .iter()
        .filter(|link| link.target == target_name)
        .cloned()
        .collect()
}

fn total_gateway_fee(contracts: &[OutgoingContract], invoice: &LightningInvoice) -> Amount {
    contracts
        .iter()
        .map(|contract| contract.amount)
        .sum::<Amount>()
        .saturating_sub(invoice.amount)
}

fn event_to_string(event: &Event) -> String {
    match event {
        Event::KeyDown(key) => format!("KeyDown: {}", key),
        Event::KeyUp(key) => format!("KeyUp: {}", key),
        Event::MouseButtonDown(button) => format!("MouseButtonDown: {}", button),
        Event::MouseButtonUp(button) => format!("MouseButtonUp: {}", button),
        Event::MouseMove(x, y) => format!("MouseMove: ({}, {})", x, y),
        Event::MouseWheel(delta) => format!("MouseWheel: {}", delta),
        Event::JoyAxis(axis, value) => format!("JoyAxis: {} {}", axis, value),
        Event::JoyButton(button) => format!("JoyButton: {}", button),
        Event::JoyHat(hat, state) => format!("JoyHat: {} {}", hat, state),
        Event::JoyBall(ball, x, y) => format!("JoyBall: {} ({}, {})", ball, x, y),
        Event::JoyTrackball(trackball, x, y) => format!("JoyTrackball: {} ({}, {})", trackball, x, y),
        Event::Text(text) => format!("Text: {}", text),
        Event::Resize(w, h) => format!("Resize: ({}, {})", w, h),
        Event::Close => "Close".to_string(),
        Event::Update => "Update".to_string(),
        Event::Draw => "Draw".to_string(),
        Event::Audio => "Audio".to_string(),
        Event::System => "System".to_string(),
        Event::FileOpen(path) => format!("FileOpen: {}", path),
        Event::FileDrop(path) => format!("FileDrop: {}", path),
        Event::FileSelect(path) => format!("FileSelect: {}", path),
        Event::FileCancel => "FileCancel".to_string(),
        Event::MemoryWarning => "MemoryWarning".to_string(),
    }
}

use fedimint_ln_common::PrunedInvoice;
use lightning_invoice::{Bolt11Invoice, Builder, Network, Error};

fn create_invoice(pruned: &PrunedInvoice, amount_msat: u64) -> Result<Bolt11Invoice, Error> {
    let mut builder = Builder::new();
    builder
        .set_invoice_id(pruned.invoice_id)
        .set_payment_hash(pruned.payment_hash)
        .set_r_hash(pruned.r_hash)
        .set_amount_msat(amount_msat)
        .set_network(Network::from_pruned_invoice(pruned))
        .set_timestamp(pruned.timestamp)
        .set_expiry_time(pruned.expiry_time)
        .set_features(pruned.features.clone())
        .set_payee(pruned.payee)
        .set_description(pruned.description.clone())
        .set_payment_secret(pruned.payment_secret.clone())
        .set_route_hints(pruned.route_hints.clone())
        .set_cltv_expiry_delta(pruned.cltv_expiry_delta)
        .set_pong_timeout(pruned.pong_timeout)
        .set_max_fee_percent(pruned.max_fee_percent)
        .set_min_final_cltv_expiry(pruned.min_final_cltv_expiry)
        .set_zeroconf(pruned.zeroconf)
        .set_unknown_fields(pruned.unknown_fields.clone());

    builder.build()
}

fn block_metadata_summary(
    parent_slot: u64,
    parent_blockhash: &str,
    slot: u64,
    blockhash: &str,
    rewards: &KeyedRewardsAndNumPartitions,
    block_time: Option<UnixTimestamp>,
    block_height: Option<u64>,
    executed_transaction_count: u64,
    entry_count: u64,
) -> String {
    let rewards_summary = rewards
        .keyed_rewards
        .iter()
        .map(|(pubkey, reward)| {
            format!(
                "Reward: {} ({} lamports, post-balance: {}, reward type: {:?}, commission: {}%)",
                pubkey,
                reward.lamports,
                reward.post_balance,
                reward.reward_type,
                reward.commission * 100
            )
        })
        .collect::<Vec<String>>()
        .join(", ");

    let reward_count = rewards.keyed_rewards.len();

    let time_str = block_time.map(|t| t.to_string()).unwrap_or("None".to_string());
    let height_str = block_height.map(|h| h.to_string()).unwrap_or("None".to_string());

    format!(
        "Block Metadata Summary:\n\
        Parent Slot: {}\n\
        Parent Blockhash: {}\n\
        Slot: {}\n\
        Blockhash: {}\n\
        Rewards: {} ({} rewards)\n\
        Block Time: {}\n\
        Block Height: {}\n\
        Executed Transactions: {}\n\
        Entry Count: {}",
        parent_slot,
        parent_blockhash,
        slot,
        blockhash,
        rewards_summary,
        reward_count,
        time_str,
        height_str,
        executed_transaction_count,
        entry_count
    )
}

        Signature::Array(inner) => is_fixed_size_signature(inner),
        Signature::Dict(inner) => is_fixed_size_signature(inner),
        Signature::Maybe(inner) => is_fixed_size_signature(inner),
        Signature::Tuple(elements) => elements.iter().all(|s| is_fixed_size_signature(s)),
        Signature::Struct(fields) => fields.iter().all(|s| is_fixed_size_signature(s)),

fn calculate_transaction_cost(rt_cfg: RuntimeConfig, gas_price: Balance, action: Action) -> Balance {
    let base_gas = match action {
        Action::CreateAccount => rt_cfg.create_account_base_gas,
        Action::DeleteAccount => rt_cfg.delete_account_base_gas,
        Action::Transfer => rt_cfg.transfer_base_gas,
        Action::Stake => rt_cfg.stake_base_gas,
        Action::AddKey => rt_cfg.add_key_base_gas,
        Action::DeleteKey => rt_cfg.delete_key_base_gas,
        Action::TransferDelegated => rt_cfg.transfer_delegated_base_gas,
        Action::ChangeDelegate => rt_cfg.change_delegate_base_gas,
        Action::DeployContract => rt_cfg.deploy_contract_base_gas,
        Action::FunctionCall => rt_cfg.function_call_base_gas,
        Action::AttachDeposit => rt_cfg.attach_deposit_base_gas,
        Action::StakeDeposit => rt_cfg.stake_deposit_base_gas,
        Action::AddKeyWithDelegation => rt_cfg.add_key_with_delegation_base_gas,
        Action::DeleteKeyFromDelegation => rt_cfg.delete_key_from_delegation_base_gas,
        _ => 0,
    };

    let gas = base_gas + rt_cfg.transaction_gas_adjustment;
    gas * gas_price
}

use crate::domain::System;

pub fn calculate_total_dock_capacity<'a, T>(system: &T) -> usize
where
    T: System<'a>,
{
    system
        .stations()
        .iter()
        .map(|station| match station.station_type() {
            Some("Asteroid base") => 1,
            Some("Coriolis Starport") => 2,
            Some("Ocellus Starport") => 2,
            Some("Orbis Starport") => 2,
            _ => 0,
        })
        .sum()
}
